## National estimate for NIVA_Fjord

### Load packages

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)
library(scales)
```

### Read data

```{r}
dat <- read_csv(
  here("data/NIVA_fjord/regulerte_elver_kyst.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cat("Number of rows:", nrow(dat), "\n")
```

### Aggregate observations to water-body level

```{r}
by_vannforekomst <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    andel_qnormal_klasse = andel_qnormal_klasse / 100
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    vannforekomstid,
    okoregion
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    andel_qnormal_klasse = mean(andel_qnormal_klasse),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Number of rows:", nrow(by_vannforekomst), "\n")
```

### Remove non-marine observations

```{r}
by_vannforekomst <- by_vannforekomst %>%
  filter(okoregion != "")

cat("Number of rows:", nrow(by_vannforekomst), "\n")

```

### Plot  
```{r}
ggplot(by_vannforekomst, aes(x = fct_rev(okoregion), y = andel_qnormal_klasse)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Region", y = "Indikator NIVA_Fjord"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

### Calculate ecoregion weights

```{r}
n_ecoregion <- table(by_vannforekomst$okoregion)

weights_tbl <- data.frame(
  okoregion = names(n_ecoregion),
  w = 1 / as.numeric(n_ecoregion)
) %>%
  mutate(
    w = w / sum(w)
  )
```

### Add weights to the data

```{r}
by_vannforekomst <- by_vannforekomst %>%
  left_join(
    weights_tbl,
    by = "okoregion"
  )
```

### Fit weighted model

```{r}
mod_weighted <- lm(
  andel_qnormal_klasse ~ 1,
  data = by_vannforekomst,
  weights = w
)
```

### Extract estimate and standard error

```{r}
res_weighted <- tidy(mod_weighted)

estimate <- res_weighted$estimate
se <- res_weighted$std.error
```

### Present results

```{r}
tibble(
  Statistic = c(
    "Weighted mean",
    "Standard error"
  ),
  Value = c(
    estimate,
    se
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Value = round(Value, 2)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

The estimated national NIVA_Fjord index was **`r round(estimate, 2)`** (SE = **`r round(se, 3)`**).

The estimate was calculated as a weighted mean across water bodies, with equal total weight assigned to each ecoregion.
